title: VP Breakdown and Passed Badge
description: Three fixes from the tester's list. (1) The VP breakdown was a hover tooltip on the VP chip: clipped off-screen on a phone, no touch way to open it, and everything that was not an objective lumped into 'Other sources'. It is now a sheet opened by tapping the chip: a tab per seat (one tap to switch, sticky header, 44 px), the points by source from the server's score facts (public objectives with stage, scored secrets by name, Custodians, Imperial, Support for the Throne, agendas, relics, other), the total the engine reports, a bar toward the points to win, Leader and points behind, and the revealed public objectives that seat has not scored. (2) A seat that passed in the action phase shows a Passed chip (with the place, 1st, 2nd, when this page saw the passes one by one) on its mat, in the seat legend over the board and in the VP sheet; cleared at the next round. (3) Breakthrough chips, Held items section and the faction card breakthrough are hidden when the table does not play Thunder's Edge (state.thunders_edge off); shown as before when on. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server (the score facts have the shape of the engine's project_score_facts). Before shots were taken on 80ce1bf1 with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and are committed under before/; npm run screenshots -- GE regenerates the after shots.

notes.title: Data
notes.text: No engine or wire change. The sheet reads the snapshot's existing score facts (ti4_host view::score, wire type ScoreFacts) and falls back to the view's scored lists when a server sends none. The engine keeps only a passed flag per seat, so the pass order is what the client saw (a pass alone in an update); passes that arrive together or were there when the page opened show Passed without a place. The vp_ledger carries no round, so the round a point was scored is not shown.

notes.title: Breakthrough content
notes.text: Breakthroughs come from the thunders_edge content source; the table flag is state.thunders_edge.
